postProcessing: None. Long-form physical source recordings; live cues are cut and mastered separately.
style: A clean close-miked studio foley recording with full-range natural acoustics and no music.

sounds.prompt: A hand briskly pulls one heavyweight uncoated cardboard index card from a tightly held stack and places it on thick wool felt. Audible paper fibers, fingertip contact, and a soft landing.
A compact stack of thick cardboard cards is placed firmly once onto a felt-covered hardwood table. A dense padded knock, slight cardstock movement, then silence.
A martial artist makes one quick arm movement in a heavy cotton jacket beside the microphone. A short rounded fabric rush with natural air displacement.
One controlled padded glove strike lands on a small leather focus mitt. Compact soft body impact, leather compression, and a tiny breath of displaced air.
A small cup of clean water is poured once into a shallow stone basin and settles. Real water movement, a rounded splash, gentle swirl, and a few natural droplets.
A dry wooden dowel wrapped in heavy cloth is snapped once by hand over a padded table. A solid low wooden break followed by soft fabric and small wood pieces settling.
One quick cloth-shod step crosses a wooden threshold and lands on soft garden soil with a few dry leaves. Natural footwear, wood, earth, and fabric movement.
A large leather bellows releases one short forceful puff of air through a wide wooden tube. A rounded pressure pulse with leather movement and no whistle.
A large rope-tensioned floor drum is struck once with a soft felt mallet while a hand damps the head. Deep natural body, restrained attack, and a short studio-room decay.
